title: Riverboat band personnel and bringing Louis Armstrong aboard
summary: Foster and the interviewers list who played trombone, trumpet, drums and clarinet on the Streckfus boat, and Foster recalls getting Baby Dodds and Louis hired.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable
